## Total Stock Biomass {.unnumbered}

Total stock biomass $B_T$ is the sum of stock biomass at age on January 1^st^. 
$$
B_T(t) = \sum\limits_{a=1}^{A}w_{P,a}(t) \cdot N_a(t) \tag{47}\label{eq:47}
$$
where $w_{P,a}(t)$ is the population mean weight of age-a fish on January 1^st^ in year $t$.
